doc: Decode a run-length encoded string: each run is a character and its decimal count (form char_count, e.g. a3b) or the count then the character (form count_char, e.g. 3ab); a missing count means 1. Run characters must not be digits. One pass, linear in input plus output.

output_size.doc: counts are single digits (at most 9), so every run of at least one input character yields at most 9 output characters: len(output) <= 9*len(input)+16
